reader.requirement: The OCCURS DEPENDING ON data-name-1 and each KEY data-name-2 may be written with qualifiers, which narrow the candidates as in any reference; at 85 an unqualified one also declared elsewhere is ambiguous.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel >= 2002: from 2002 a data description entry clause operand (ODO data-name-1, SAME AS, OCCURS KEY, RENAMES) takes the groups above its subject as implicit qualifiers; below 2002 the whole scope's candidates are counted, so a name declared beside the subject and in another record must be qualified

Edition.Cite: only the SR3 message text of COBOL2353 (the candidate set's edition step is IdentifyRegionOperand's, via ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers); OccursKeyItemFault's Year<2002 arm is SR12's, not these rules'
Edition.Cite: only the citation text of the COBOL1639 ambiguity message (1985 IV.4.3.8.1 vs 2023 8.4.2.2.3 SR1); the verdict (one survivor resolves, several is an error) is the same code

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 the clause operand's candidates are the whole scope's (qualification needed when the name is also declared in another record); from 2002 the groups above the subject are implicit qualifiers
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf10_04 does not exercise a qualified ODO counter beside a same-named item in another record, nor a qualified KEY

reader.notes: DEPENDING ON CNT OF GC OF CTLS binds the CTLS counter (SEARCH ALL bounded at 3, then 2), and KEY IS K OF ROW and K2 IN KG OF ROW bind; the unqualified forms are refused at 85 and accepted at 2002, the correct 1985 arm.
